2.209.26
Map.TextAntiAliasingQuality
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The Map.TextAntiAliasingQuality element specifies the anti-aliasing quality for the text of a Map.
This element is optional. If this element is present, its value MUST be a String ([XMLSCHEMA2/2]
section 3.2.1) or an expression that evaluates to a String.
The value of this element MUST be one of the following or an expression that evaluates to one of the
following:
High: High anti-aliasing quality is applied to text.
Normal: Normal anti-aliasing quality is applied to text.
SystemDefault: System default anti-aliasing quality is applied to text.
If this element is not present, its value is interpreted as "High".
The following is the parent element of the Map.TextAntiAliasingQuality element.
Parent elements
Map
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Map.TextAntiAliasingQuality element.
 <xsd:element name="TextAntiAliasingQuality" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
